[[File:Jedi_monumentpic.jpg|thumb]]
The '''Jedi monument''' of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] was a bubble building that remembered the great deed [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had done for the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[New Otoh Gunga]]. The building housed two [[eternal flame orb]]s. The Gungans also built similar buildings to commemorate other [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who had done a service to help the Gungan people.
